text:
sam: deploy-bot kicking off staged rollout v3.2.1 -> 5% global (priority routes). change window 03:00-05:00 UTC. watching p99 / 5xx / embed errors. initial prefetch probe shows mem +8% on some hosts.

deploy-bot: [DEPLOY] canary started — id=deploy-8599990001 target=5% version=v3.2.1 routes=[search-text, chat-stream]

lin: seeing p99 +20ms in ap-south. p95 looks fine. attaching a quick trace.

maya: can we predefine a pin for eu-west if this gets worse? ops-sre?

ops-sre: standing by. recommend thresholds: p99>450ms OR 5xx>0.4% sustained 2m => pause/rollback. watching k8s OOMs + kvcache evictions.

sam: ack. set rollback triggers as ops-sre suggested and enable soft-fallback to v3.2.0 for affected routes.

deploy-bot: scheduled bump 5% -> 20% in 10m. react with :thumbsup: to proceed, :stop_sign: to hold.

jordan: :thumbsup:

lin: holding — digging ap-southeast traces now, I'm seeing frontend timeouts from pool-3.

maya: hold from me too. getting 502s from model-host-7. sam can you pin region or pause bump?

sam: pausing the bump. @deploy-bot hold the rollout — reason: regional 502s in ap-south.

deploy-bot: [ACTION] Rollout paused at 5% by sam. Reason="regional 502s (model-host-7)". Options: pin affected regions to v3.2.0, apply per-route fallback, or rollback. Please confirm next step.

ops-sre: recommend pin eu & ap-south to v3.2.0 and drain model-host-7. starting drain now.

lin: trace: https://traces.internal/8599990001 — root cause looks like kv-cache thrash after prefetch bump; host eviction spikes.

maya: does draining host require full rollback? can we do per-route fallback? search-text and chat-stream are tagged.

ops-sre: we can do per-route fallback via routing policy patch. will apply fallback for `search-text` in ap-south first.

sam: go ahead ops-sre. also draft quick release-note blurb: "Paused staged rollout v3.2.1 due to regional model host kv-cache thrash; investigating. No rollback yet."

deploy-bot: applied routing patch: search-text -> fallback v3.2.0 in ap-south. change propagated in ~30s.

maya: metrics on search-text stabilized: p99 620ms -> 210ms after fallback. nice.

lin: model-host-7 memory still elevated. ops-sre confirm drain progress?

ops-sre: model-host-7 drained ~65% sessions; eviction rate down. host cordoned for now.

sam: consensus check: if no regressions in 10m we resume bump to 20%. thumbs?

jordan: :thumbsup:

maya: :thumbsup:

lin: :thumbsup: after 10m watch

deploy-bot: scheduling bump to 20% in 10m. Reply with :stop_sign: to cancel.

sam: noted. I'll update release notes and annotate incident.

ops-sre: follow-up action: add kv-prefetch smoothing to staged-rollout config to avoid cache thrash on warmups. will open a PR.

sam: thanks all — keeping this thread for postmortem notes and changelog update.
